newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares of Japanese construction firms fall.
newsitem.headline: Shares of Japanese construction firms fall.

text.p: Shares in construction firms fell on Thursday morning on weakening hopes for more government public spending to prop up the economy and worries over the construction industry's financial health, traders said.
The share price of Taisei Corp was down 17 yen at 654 yen at 0119 GMT, on volume of 707,000 shares.
Obayashi Corp was down 25 yen at 868 yen, on volume of 244,000 shares.

"Growing calls to review public spending (as a measure to support the economic recovery), which had supported the sector, are dragging down the shares," said a trader at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
